ratio_refund-policy_default.title: Refund & Return Policy
ratio_refund-policy_default.subtitle: We want you to love what you ordered. If something isn't right, here's how returns, exchanges, and refunds work.

sections.heading: Returns
sections.body: You may return most items within 30 days of delivery for a refund or exchange, provided they are unused, in their original condition, and in the original packaging.

sections.heading: Non-Returnable Items
sections.body: Certain items cannot be returned, including:
bullets: Personal-care items that have been opened or used

sections.heading: How to Start a Return
body: To start a return, contact our support team with your order number and the item(s) you'd like to return.
Once your request is approved, we'll share return instructions and the return shipping address.

sections.heading: Refunds
sections.body: After we receive and inspect your return, we'll notify you of the approval status. Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method within 5–10 business days.

sections.heading: Exchanges
sections.body: If you need a different size or variant, the fastest way is to return the original item and place a new order once your return is approved.

sections.heading: Damaged or Incorrect Items
sections.body: If you received a damaged, defective, or incorrect item, contact us within 48 hours of delivery and we'll make it right at no extra cost.
